description:
Which best sellers have the most complete listings? TOP 10 of the Wintraits Scan Index of a category.
(¿Qué más vendidos tienen la ficha más completa? Ranking del Índice Wintraits Scan.)

Among today's best sellers, the 10 with the highest Wintraits Scan Index (out of sample) and the index traits
each listing has (`rasgos`), with the best sellers' middle half (`franja_mas_vendidos`). Brand, title and Amazon
link only for listings with an index of 60 or more. Use it as examples of how the best sellers present the
winning traits; the number is not comparable across categories and is not a sales probability.

Args:
    categoria: Scan category id (see wintraits_buscar_categoria; e.g. "freidoras").
    pais: country code (e.g. "ES").
    lang: "es" (default) or "en".

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-03-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-mar-2027).
name: wintraits_ranking
